name: Aquaguard UTC UV Booster
summary: Aquaguard UTC UV Booster is a compact under-counter inline water purifier designed for modular kitchens.
intro: Aquaguard UTC UV Booster is a compact under-the-counter (UTC) inline water purifier designed for modular kitchens. It provides purified drinking water through multi-stage filtration and UV purification, with the added goodness of active copper and zinc, all without requiring a storage tank.

Suitable for TDS up to 200 mg/L
